description: This file defines the 'Modification' class within the Opencart Admin Model setting namespace. It manages CRUD operations related to modifications, including adding, deleting, updating status, and retrieving modifications in the database.

classes.name: Modification
classes.description: Represents the Modification model for managing modifications within the Opencart admin setting namespace.

methods.name: addModification
methods.description: Inserts a new modification record into the database with provided data.

methods.name: deleteModification
methods.description: Deletes a modification record based on its ID.

methods.name: deleteModificationsByExtensionInstallId
methods.description: Removes all modifications associated with a specific extension install ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a modification identified by its ID.

methods.name: getModification
methods.description: Retrieves a modification record by its ID.

methods.name: getModifications
methods.description: Returns a list of modifications, with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalModifications
methods.description: Returns the total count of modifications.

methods.name: getModificationByCode
methods.description: Fetches a modification record by its unique code.
